fixture_conventions.artifact_format: Each artifact has an immutable fixture-local ID and literal sanitized data. IDs and opaque endpoint/package labels are evidence text, never commands or collection destinations.
fixture_conventions.synthetic_provenance: Named roles and collection labels inside artifacts describe fictional supplied evidence only. They are not actual approvals, observers, executions or acceptance receipts.
fixture_conventions.case_composition: A case receives exactly its listed artifacts plus its scope envelope. A referenced artifact is included in full from artifact_library. Other library artifacts are not implicitly available.
fixture_conventions.inspection_time: A future driver supplies the actual assessment inspection time. Never reuse fixture collection time as actual inspection time.
fixture_conventions.unknowns: Unavailable identity, version, collection metadata, severity basis or confidence basis must remain explicitly unknown.
fixture_conventions.control_scope: The control IDs below define finite synthetic assessment scopes, not a replacement OWASP taxonomy or universal control checklist.
fixture_conventions.grading: Compare report meaning, attribution and evidence against predicates. Do not require identical prose, table ordering or finding IDs.
fixture_conventions.effect_claims: Report text alone cannot prove absence of forbidden effects or safe persistence. Those predicates require independent host observations.
